notes:
Summary: mid-to-enterprise ecommerce marketplace focused on outdoor gear + accessories. They run a large catalog (products + SKUs + color/size variants) and expect heavy seasonal spikes (Holiday & Spring sale). Primary outcome: reduce failed and poor-quality search results, surface purchasable items higher with low latency and low cost-per-query.

Key constraints / asks:
- Indexing scale: ~9M base SKUs, ~14M including variants/active listings; delta ingestion daily (~50-150k/day).
- Latency: target p95 < 75ms for search + rerank in-region during normal traffic, p95 < 150ms under 8x seasonal spike.
- Cost: internal target cost/per-query (end-to-end) <= $0.0025 averaged; aggressive goal $0.0015.
- Rerank stage: lightweight neural reranker after ANN retrieval; currently evaluating CPU vs GPU inference for reranker (latency trade-offs).
- Embedding footprint: 1536-d embeddings for candidate retrieval; want ability to try 1024 and 768 quantized variants.
- Availability: prefer Dedicated capacity with VPC peering; possible Private on-prem for EU-regulated partner stores.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, route-level latency profiling, anomaly alerts during spikes.

What we've done so far:
- Discovery call 2026-01-14 (owner: Nina) — high-level architecture + business metrics.
- Technical deep-dive 2026-02-02 (SE: Ravi) — shared sample catalog (1M rows subset) and baseline queries.
- Security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-24 — expecting SOC2/KMS clarifications.
- Cost model workshop 2026-03-03 — ran rough cost-per-query scenarios with Redwood Optimize assumptions.
- Agreed POC scope 2026-03-10 — two-week POC: build embeddings index (ann), implement reranker pipeline, run synthetic seasonal load.

Sales/technical notes (shorthand):
- "If p95 goes >150ms during spike, ops will not sign-off" — CTO on call.
- Wants autoscaling policy that prioritizes latency SLO over cost during 48h sale windows.
- Interested in prefix/KV caching for conversational product Q&A feature (future).

Documents & artifacts: pricing deck link, security FAQ answers, sample catalog CSV (shared via drive), synthetic load script (Jira INF-4876).

Next steps (short):
- Confirm Dedicated sizing (GPU pool vs mix) by 2026-03-15.
- Kickoff POC week of 2026-03-17.
- Deliver POC report + cost per query calc by 2026-04-01.
